content: Compose an email to a supplier to request additional product samples.

Subject: Request for additional product samples

Dear [Supplier’s Name],

I hope this email finds you well. Firstly, I would like to thank you for the samples of [product name] that you sent us earlier. Our team found them to be of high quality and we are interested in exploring your product range further.

I would like to request additional product samples from your company. We are particularly interested in [specific product types or specifications]. We believe that these products are suitable for our market, and we would like to review their quality and suitability for our business.

Could you please send us [quantity and variations of the products]? We would appreciate it if you could also include pricing information and estimated delivery times for each product sample.

Please let us know if there are any charges associated with the product samples, and if so, the amount and payment options. We will be happy to pay for the samples if necessary.

I would appreciate it if you could confirm receipt of this email and provide us with an estimated delivery date for the samples. Also, please don’t hesitate to contact me if you have any questions or need additional information.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
